_notes.hook: string or list per language: a list makes one video per hook (A/B), each opening on another moment
_notes.logo: PNG with alpha for the end card (instead of the title text)
_notes.music: track from Alex; empty = generated beat bed in ads (--no-beat to turn off)
_notes.bpm: tempo of the music: cuts land on beats
_notes.corner_logo: story ads: keep the logo PNG small in the top-left corner for the whole video
_notes.colors.banner: plate colour of story banners (hook, event captions), like the game's own RUN! banner
_notes.banner_y: 0 = top; 0.0-1.0 = banner centre as a share of the height, when the game's own top UI sits there
